basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautiful, updated home that boasts over 1,900 sqft of living space, ideal for multi-generational families. This bright and spacious 3 bed, 2 bath home is drenched in natural light, highlighted by modern finishes and an open-concept design ideal for entertaining. The chef's kitchen is a dream come true, featuring beautiful countertops, ample cabinet space, stainless steel appliances, and a layout that flows into the main living areas. Recessed lighting and skylights add an elegant touch throughout, enhancing the home's warm and welcoming atmosphere. Upstairs, you'll find 2 generously sized bedrooms and a sleek, contemporary bathroom complete with a skylight, separate shower, and bathtub. The flexible lower level, accessible by a separate entrance, offers a 3rd bedroom, an additional bathroom with a dual vanity, and a spacious family room, perfect for added privacy or as an in-law suite. With 1 car parking and a serene backyard with expansive views, this property offers outdoor space where you can relax, unwind, build your dream garden, and enjoy your evening beverage. Don't miss your chance to own this beautiful home that perfectly balances modern comfort with a touch of elegance, ideal for versatile living and entertaining in this sunny neighborhood.
